cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(electrode_heat_feedback LANGUAGES CXX)
find_package(MFEM 4.10 CONFIG REQUIRED)
find_package(MPI REQUIRED COMPONENTS CXX)
add_library(electrode-heat-feedback INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(electrode-heat-feedback INTERFACE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
target_link_libraries(electrode-heat-feedback INTERFACE mfem MPI::MPI_CXX)
target_compile_features(electrode-heat-feedback INTERFACE cxx_std_17)
add_executable(electrode-heat-feedback-tests test_feedback.cpp)
target_link_libraries(electrode-heat-feedback-tests PRIVATE electrode-heat-feedback)
